Перший профілактичний огляд зазвичай рек: A first preventive check-up is usually recommended around age 7, when permanent teeth begin replacing baby teeth. If you notice difficulties chewing, pronounced asymmetry, mouth breathing or other concerns, seek advice earlier. A check-up does not always mean starting treatment; sometimes observation is enough.
Чим відрізняються елайнери від брекетів?: How do aligners differ from braces?
Брекети — незнімна система, а елайнери —: Braces are fixed, while aligners are removable clear trays that are changed in sequence. Aligners require consistent wear according to the prescribed schedule. The choice depends on your bite, the complexity of tooth movements, oral health and your ability to follow the plan. Both methods require assessment and professional monitoring.
Ортодонтичне лікування можливе й у дорос: Orthodontic treatment is possible in adulthood. The condition of your teeth, gums and supporting bone, as well as general health, matters. Some cases require collaboration with other specialists. Suitability, limitations and expected changes are assessed individually after examination.
Скільки триває ортодонтичне лікування?: How long does orthodontic treatment take?
Тривалість залежить від діагнозу, віку,: Duration depends on the diagnosis, age, case complexity, method and adherence to recommendations. An initial estimate can be discussed after assessment and may change during treatment. The active phase is usually followed by retention to help maintain tooth positions.

Так. Огляд, аналіз фотографій і цифрових: Yes. Examination, photographs and digital models or impressions help inform the plan. X-rays and other investigations are prescribed only when clinically indicated. Do not arrange a CT scan or other imaging yourself before the consultation; the doctor will determine what is needed.
